sn.s: El primer recibo de la luz me asusta.
sn.e: The first electricity bill frightens me.

sn.s: Dice que debo mil ochocientos córdobas.
sn.e: It says I owe one thousand eight hundred córdobas.

sn.s: Yo vivo solo en una casa chiquita.
sn.e: I live alone in a small house.

sn.s: Tengo un abanico y tres bombillos.
sn.e: I have one fan and three light bulbs.

sn.s: No puede ser tanto consumo.
sn.e: It cannot be that much consumption.

sn.s: Le enseño el recibo a don Beto.
sn.e: I show the bill to don Beto.

sn.s: Don Beto lo revisa despacio.
sn.e: Don Beto looks it over slowly.

sn.s: "Aquí hay un error", dice él.
sn.e: "There's a mistake here," he says.

sn.s: "Le están cobrando el mes de antes."
sn.e: "They're charging you the month before."

sn.s: El mes de antes yo no vivía ahí.
sn.e: The month before I did not live there.

sn.s: Vivía todavía donde doña Carmen.
sn.e: I was still living at doña Carmen's.

sn.s: Entonces me están cobrando lo del dueño.
sn.e: So they are charging me the owner's bill.

sn.s: "Hay que reclamar", dice don Beto.
sn.e: "You have to complain," don Beto says.

sn.s: Vamos juntos a la oficina.
sn.e: We go to the office together.

sn.s: Llegamos a las siete de la mañana.
sn.e: We arrive at seven in the morning.

sn.s: Ya hay una fila de treinta personas.
sn.e: There is already a queue of thirty people.

sn.s: Todos van a reclamar algo.
sn.e: They are all going to complain about something.

sn.s: Esperamos dos horas en la fila.
sn.e: We wait two hours in the queue.

sn.s: Don Beto no se molesta por la espera.
sn.e: Don Beto is not bothered by the wait.

sn.s: Habla con la gente de la fila.
sn.e: He talks to the people in the queue.

sn.s: Al final llegamos a la ventanilla.
sn.e: Finally we get to the window.

sn.s: Yo empiezo a hablar rápido y enojado.
sn.e: I start talking fast and annoyed.

sn.s: "Este recibo está mal. Yo no debo eso."
sn.e: "This bill is wrong. I don't owe that."

sn.s: La señora de la ventanilla se pone dura.
sn.e: The woman at the window goes hard.

sn.s: "El sistema dice lo que dice", contesta.
sn.e: "The system says what it says," she answers.

sn.s: Y ahí ya no avanzo nada.
sn.e: And from there I get nowhere.

sn.s: Don Beto me toca el brazo.
sn.e: Don Beto touches my arm.

sn.s: Y empieza a hablar él.
sn.e: And he starts talking instead.

sn.s: "Buenas, seño. Disculpe la molestia."
sn.e: "Buenas, señorita. Sorry to trouble you."

sn.s: "Fíjese que tenemos un problemita."
sn.e: "The thing is, we've got a small problem."

sn.s: Habla despacio y con calma.
sn.e: He talks slowly and calmly.

sn.s: No dice que ella está mal.
sn.e: He does not say she is wrong.

sn.s: Dice que hay un problema, de nadie.
sn.e: He says there is a problem, nobody's fault.

sn.s: La señora se ablanda enseguida.
sn.e: The woman softens straight away.

sn.s: Revisa el recibo otra vez.
sn.e: She checks the bill again.

sn.s: Después revisa algo en la computadora.
sn.e: Then she checks something on the computer.

sn.s: "Ah, sí. Aquí está el problema", dice ella.
sn.e: "Ah, yes. Here's the problem," she says.

sn.s: En diez minutos lo arregla.
sn.e: In ten minutes she sorts it out.

sn.s: Me hace un recibo nuevo por doscientos.
sn.e: She makes me a new bill for two hundred.

sn.s: Doscientos, no mil ochocientos.
sn.e: Two hundred, not one thousand eight hundred.

sn.s: Salimos y yo no entiendo qué pasó.
sn.e: We come out and I do not understand what happened.

sn.s: "Yo dije lo mismo que usted", digo yo.
sn.e: "I said the same thing you did," I say.

sn.s: "No", dice don Beto. "Usted la culpó."
sn.e: "No," don Beto says. "You blamed her."

sn.s: "Yo le pedí ayuda."
sn.e: "I asked her for help."

sn.s: Esa es toda la diferencia.
sn.e: That is the whole difference.

sn.s: Aquí uno no reclama contra la persona.
sn.e: Here you do not complain against the person.

sn.s: Uno le pide a la persona que le ayude.
sn.e: You ask the person to help you.

sn.s: Aunque la persona sea la del error.
sn.e: Even if that person is the one who made the mistake.

sn.s: Esa es la puerta y hay que tocarla bien.
sn.e: That is the door and you have to knock properly.
